forcePath.interpretation: Total fallback-vs-CIO result, including Earth-orientation/model setting and integration effects; not an isolated precession-defect measurement.
forcePath.source: tests/lib/orekitCases.mjs requestInputs: LEO400 F0-point-mass, override drag=true; keep only first requested sample as target (01:00 UTC). RK78 tolerance 1e-13, maxStep 300 s. Compare identical requests with/without earth_orientation input.

about: Measured offline in C++/shipped WASM. Coefficient table is read directly from pinned ERFA nut80.c. All 50 stored UTC epochs; angular comparisons at HPOP jdTtUsed. Metre values are rotation bounds at LEO 6778137 m, GPS 26560000 m, GEO 42164170 m, except wasmEcef entries are actual x-axis-state differences. No HPOP source changes.
